text.aria-label: Title text 'Observed power and three day-ahead medians around 8 labelled events and verified transfers at the Primaries'
text.tspan: Observed power and three day-ahead medians around 8 labelled events
and verified transfers at the Primaries

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Observed cleaned power and the day-ahead median (leads 0 to 24 h, stitched over daily 12:00 UTC origins) of the stored normal-running forecast, the G-lb corrected forecast, and the N-gate corrected forecast (real graph, post hoc), in percent of capacity, for 14 days before to 7 days after the start of the event, at a Primary with signed-MW or MVA-only metering. Dark grey band: the event of the panel, from its start to its end, clipped at day 7. Light grey bands: other events or transfers at the same Primary in the window. Lines break where telemetry is missing.'
text.tspan: Observed cleaned power and the day-ahead median (leads 0 to 24 h, stitched over daily 12:00 UTC
origins) of the stored normal-running forecast, the G-lb corrected forecast, and the N-gate
corrected forecast (real graph, post hoc), in percent of capacity, for 14 days before to 7 days
after the start of the event, at a Primary with signed-MW or MVA-only metering. Dark grey band:
the event of the panel, from its start to its end, clipped at day 7. Light grey bands: other
events or transfers at the same Primary in the window. Lines break where telemetry is missing.
